S-end.name: Âm cuối
S-end.tip: Người Việt hay nuốt âm cuối (fish, rice, check, book). Đọc rõ phụ âm cuối mỗi từ, nhất là /k/, /t/, /s/, /ʃ/.

S-s.name: Đuôi -s, -es
S-s.tip: Danh từ số nhiều và động từ ngôi thứ ba phải nghe được âm /s/ hoặc /z/ ở cuối. Thiếu đuôi này là lỗi phổ biến nhất khi chấm Speaking.

S-ed.name: Đuôi -ed
S-ed.tip: Đuôi -ed đọc /t/ (watched), /d/ (cleaned) hoặc /ɪd/ (visited, wanted). Không bỏ đuôi, vì đó là dấu hiệu thì quá khứ.

S-th.name: Âm th
S-th.tip: Đặt đầu lưỡi giữa hai hàm răng rồi thổi hơi: think, three (/θ/) hoặc this, mother (/ð/). Đừng đọc thành t, d hay s.

S-stress.name: Trọng âm từ dài
S-stress.tip: Từ nhiều âm tiết có một âm nhấn mạnh: PHAR-ma-cy, u-ni-VER-si-ty, MED-i-cal, CHEM-is-try. Nhấn sai, người nghe khó nhận ra từ.

S-num.name: Số đếm
S-num.tip: Phân biệt thirteen (nhấn cuối: thir-TEEN) với thirty (nhấn đầu: THIR-ty). Cặp này rất hay gặp trong Listening.

read.text: I like to cook fish and rice at night.
My friend works at a big hospital.
We need to check the price before we buy it.
I usually take a bus to the market.
Please put the book back on the desk.
She sells medicines in a small shop near my house.
My students always ask a lot of questions.
He reads two newspapers every morning.
Rooms in the city centre are very expensive.
My parents grow vegetables in their garden.
I watched a film and then cleaned my room.
We visited the beach and walked along the sand.
She started the course last year and finished it in May.
I wanted to travel, so I saved some money.
The teacher asked us to repeat the words.
I think three of my friends are thirsty.
This is the third month of the year.
My mother and father both like the weather here.
I want to thank the doctor for her help.
There are thirty students in this class.
I am a pharmacy student at a medical university.
Chemistry is an important subject for pharmacists.
I teach mathematics to secondary school students.
Travelling helps me understand different cultures.
I am interested in economics and personal finance.
The room costs fifteen dollars a night, not fifty.
The class starts at seven thirty in the morning.
I have lived here for thirteen years.
Fourteen of my forty students passed the test.
The bus leaves at six fifteen every evening.

part1.hint: Nói tên quê, vị trí, một đặc điểm, và bao lâu em về một lần.
part1.sample: My hometown is Ha Nam, a small province in the north of Vietnam, about sixty kilometres from Hanoi. It is quite peaceful and there are a lot of rice fields. Now I study in Vinh, so I only go back two or three times a year, usually at Tet.

part1.q: What do you like most about your hometown?
part1.hint: Chọn một điều, nói lý do và một ví dụ cụ thể.
part1.sample: I like the food and the people most. Life there is slower than in the city, and my neighbours are very friendly. For example, when I come home, they often bring fruit from their gardens to my house.

part1.q: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
part1.hint: Em thuê phòng trọ ở Vinh: tả phòng, ở với ai, gần trường không.
part1.sample: At the moment I rent a small room near my university in Vinh. It is not very big, but it has everything I need, like a bed, a desk and a small kitchen. The best thing is that I can walk to school in ten minutes.

part1.q: What would you like to change about the place where you live?
part1.hint: Nêu một điều muốn đổi và vì sao.
part1.sample: I would like a bigger window, because my room is quite dark in the morning. I also wish it was quieter, because there is a lot of traffic on the street outside, so sometimes it is hard to concentrate when I study.

part1.hint: Ngành Dược năm 3, học gì, thấy thế nào.
part1.sample: I am a third-year pharmacy student at Vinh Medical University. We study subjects like chemistry, biology and how medicines work in the body. It is quite difficult, especially chemistry, but I find it really useful.

part1.q: Why did you choose to study pharmacy?
part1.hint: Lý do: thích hóa, muốn giúp người, cơ hội việc làm.
part1.sample: There are two main reasons. First, I was good at chemistry at high school. Second, I want a job that helps people stay healthy. Pharmacists can advise patients about their medicines, and I think that is an important job.

part1.q: Do you have a part-time job?
part1.hint: Em dạy thêm Toán: dạy ai, mấy buổi, thấy thế nào.
part1.sample: Yes, I do. I teach maths to two secondary school students, three evenings a week. It helps me earn some extra money, and I also learn how to explain things clearly, which will be useful in my future job.

part1.hint: Có hay không, điều em thích và điều khó.
part1.sample: Yes, most of the time. I feel happy when my students understand a difficult problem and get better marks. However, it can be tiring, especially when they are not interested in the lesson and I have to find new ways to explain.

part1.hint: Có, kể một chuyến đi gần đây.
part1.sample: Yes, I love travelling. Last summer I went to Da Nang with my friends. We swam in the sea, visited the old town in Hoi An and tried a lot of local food. Travelling helps me relax after a stressful semester.

part1.q: Where would you like to travel in the future?
part1.hint: Nơi muốn đến, lý do, đi với ai.
part1.sample: I would really like to visit Japan one day. I want to see the cherry blossoms in spring and experience the culture there. I think I will need to save money for a long time, but I believe it will be worth it.

part1.q: Is it easy for you to save money?
part1.hint: Dễ hay khó, em tiết kiệm bằng cách nào.
part1.sample: It is not very easy, because I am a student and I have to pay for my room and food. But I try to save a little every month from my teaching job. For example, I cook at home instead of eating out, and I write down everything I spend.

part1.q: What do you usually spend money on?
part1.hint: Những khoản chính, khoản nào nhiều nhất.
part1.sample: Most of my money goes on rent and food. I also spend some money on books for my course and on transport when I go back to my hometown. Sometimes I buy clothes, but I try not to spend too much on them.
